nodes.name: Webhook — HubSpot no-show event
nodes.notes: Configure a HubSpot Workflow that POSTs here when meetingOutcome = 'no_show'. Body must include meetingId, contactId, ownerId.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Pull Meeting + Owner
nodes.notes: Returns the meeting plus associated contact and owner IDs. Use Private App token (not OAuth) for server-to-server.

nodes.name: Eligibility Guard
nodes.notes: Three guards: not opted out, has email, no-show window has actually passed (avoid sending to people who joined late).

parameters.query:
SELECT meeting_id, completed_at
FROM hubspot_meetings_raw
WHERE contact_id = $1
  AND outcome = 'completed'
  AND completed_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY completed_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Postgres — Recent Meeting Lookup
nodes.notes: Drives tone branching: if a completed meeting exists in the last 90d, use 'we missed you', else use 'let's get you scheduled'.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Pull AE Owner
nodes.notes: Need owner email + scheduling link for delegated send and the two pre-picked slots.

nodes.name: Claude — Opener Line
nodes.notes: Cap output at 320 tokens; the opener is one sentence. The body of the email is the approved template — only the opener is generated.

nodes.name: Gmail — Send Step 1 (delegated)
nodes.notes: Uses the AE's delegated Gmail send. SPF/DKIM/DMARC must be configured on the AE's domain or replies/deliverability will tank.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO recovery_state (
  contact_id, meeting_id, owner_id, email, ae_email,
  tone, current_step, status, started_at, next_due_at,
  step1_sent_at, step1_opener
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
  $6, 1, 'active', now(), now() + interval '2 days',
  now(), $7
)
ON CONFLICT (meeting_id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_step = 1,
  status = 'active',
  next_due_at = now() + interval '2 days',
  step1_sent_at = now(),
  step1_opener = EXCLUDED.step1_opener;

nodes.name: Cron — Step 2/3 Sweep
nodes.notes: Every 15 minutes during business hours, Mon-Fri. Timezone is set in workflow Settings (America/New_York by default — change to your AE timezone).

parameters.query:
SELECT
  contact_id, meeting_id, owner_id, email, ae_email,
  tone, current_step,
  step1_opener,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - started_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_since_start
FROM recovery_state
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND next_due_at <= now()
  AND current_step IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY next_due_at ASC
LIMIT 50;

UPDATE recovery_state
SET
  current_step = $2,
  last_touched_at = now(),
  next_due_at = CASE
    WHEN $3::boolean THEN NULL
    ELSE now() + ($4 || ' days')::interval
  END,
  status = CASE
    WHEN $3::boolean THEN 'completed'
    ELSE 'active'
  END
WHERE meeting_id = $1
RETURNING current_step, status, next_due_at;

nodes.name: Reply Trigger — AE Inbox
nodes.notes: Independent trigger watching the AE mailbox. Fires on every inbound, including STOP/unsubscribe and human replies.

parameters.query:
UPDATE recovery_state
SET
  status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'opt_out' THEN 'opted_out' ELSE 'exited' END,
  exited_at = now(),
  exit_reason = $2,
  next_due_at = NULL
WHERE email = $1 AND status = 'active'
RETURNING contact_id, owner_id, ae_email, current_step;

nodes.name: HubSpot — Tag Exit on Contact
nodes.notes: Writes the exit reason back to the HubSpot contact so reporting can roll it up alongside meetings.
